songs.name: He Was A Friend Of Mine
And We Bid You Good Night

ai_show_review.summary: Adventurous segues, fierce Rhythm Devils and killer early jams
ai_show_review.blurb: The show rides high on smoking transitions like China Cat → The Eleven and a blistering Death Don't Have No Mercy/​Doin' That Rag finale. Jerry’s guitar is lyrical and enthusiastic while the Rhythm Devils close out the set with raw power.
ai_show_review.review: Recorded on May 24, 1969 at the Seminole Indian Reservation, this performance captures the Dead in full experimental flight. The first half rolls through a bright Turn On Your Lovelight into a seamless Doin' That Rag → He Was A Friend Of Mine flow before launching into the classic China Cat Sunflower → The Eleven segue that still feels fresh and daring. Jerry Garcia’s playing is described as “great Gar’s enthusiasm” – lyrical, eager and driving the band forward. The rhythm section, especially the Rhythm Devils, builds a thunderous climax after Alligator, despite a brief pause before Saint Stephen; their power is evident even when one recording notes a thinner mix. Highlights include the soulful Death Don't Have No Mercy, the raucous Doin' That Rag finale, and an inspired Feedback stretch that caps the set. While a secondary soundboard capture shows some technical hiccups and uneven moments, the pristine KPFA recording delivers crisp, hiss‑free audio that lets every nuance of this adventurous night shine.

best_recording.reason: Pristine, hiss‑free soundboard capture with excellent clarity and full set; showcases the standout segues and powerful Rhythm Devils ending.

key_highlights: Smoking segue China Cat Sunflower → The Eleven that keeps the momentum soaring.
Epic Death Don't Have No Mercy / Doin' That Rag finale with raw, lyrical intensity.
Powerful Rhythm Devils conclusion after Alligator into Saint Stephen and Feedback.

band_performance.Jerry: Enthusiastic, lyrical guitar work with great energy throughout the set.
band_performance.Mickey: Provides a powerful Rhythm Devils climax; on one recording the drum mix sounds thin but the ending remains forceful.
band_performance.Billy: Delivers solid drive and contributes to the thunderous final stretch, despite occasional thinness in the mix.
